page_title: Tattoo Try On | See a Tattoo on Your Body Before You Ink

sources.entry: TattooTryOn - Placing and sizing a tattoo on your photo is free in the browser. When it looks right, 5 credits buys a realistic render. Plans from $4.99 a month. #freemium #design

summary.name: TattooTryOn
summary.one_liner: A browser-based tattoo try-on tool that places a chosen design on a photo of your own arm, back or leg and uses AI to render it as a realistic healed tattoo.
use_cases: Previewing a tattoo on your own arm, back or leg before booking
Checking size and placement of a design on your body
Comparing two tattoo designs on the same photo
Showing a mockup to your tattoo artist
Turning a paper sketch into a placed tattoo preview
summary.what_it_does: The free placement preview runs in the browser: you upload a body photo or pick a sample, choose one of 340 library designs or upload your own, then drag, resize and rotate the design onto bare skin. The preview can be downloaded as a PNG without an account. Pressing "Make it look real" sends the placed design to AI, which renders it as a healed tattoo that follows the photo's skin tone, lighting and body contours, with a before/after slider. Clothing and hair are kept on top of the ink. Renders take roughly 30 seconds to a minute.
notable: Placement is set by hand before AI rendering, so the result keeps the chosen position, size and angle
Free in-browser placement preview with no sign-up; works on phone or desktop
Supports uploading your own design or a photo of a paper sketch, with background removed automatically
Render cost scales by resolution: 5 credits at 1K, 8 at 2K, 10 at 4K
caveats: AI renders cost credits; signed-in free accounts get 5 credits per month (one 1K render), and paid plans add more
Plans start from $4.99 a month per the listing
Renders show a healed tattoo and may occasionally alter a small detail next to the design
